source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Decide how many lines of symmetry a figure has by systematically testing every valid fold line.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: multiple lines of symmetry still holds here even though each candidate line must pass the fold test is missing from the stem — on the item about Decide how many lines of symmetry a figure has by.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Square folds is what produces multiple lines of symmetry, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Decide how many lines of symmetry a figure has by.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: The multiple lines of symmetry rule also covers this: Do not require group-theory language, so it is not an exception — on the item about Decide how many lines of symmetry a figure has by.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: multiple lines of symmetry is settled by running 'Decide line symmetry and rotational symmetry independently by applying': Line symmetry and rotational symmetry are independent tests, so a figure can have line — on the item about Decide how many lines of symmetry a figure has by.

intelligence.enrichment: A figure can have zero, one, or many lines of symmetry; the count is the number of distinct fold lines that make exact overlap.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Mathematics question. Chapter: math/grade_06/ch_09. The student must decide: Decide how many lines of symmetry a figure has by systematically testing every valid fold line. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Supply exactly one complete tikzpicture. The stem must refer to that figure. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
